result: China has always upholds an attitude of openness, transparency, and responsibility in handling the issue of the origin of COVID-19, actively supporting and participating in global scientific research cooperation on viral origins tracing. At the early stage of the outbreak, China established cooperative relationships with international organizations such as the World Health Organization, sharing information and contributing to global pandemic prevention and control as well as origins-tracing research. Experts from the WHO and other countries visited China twice for origins-tracing research; the Chinese government provided strong support and assistance for their work in China, fully demonstrating China's open, transparent, and responsible attitude. China firmly opposes any politicization of the origins question and believes that origins tracing should be carried out through scientific cooperation by scientists and medical experts. China will continue to work together with the international community to make new contributions to global anti-pandemic cooperation and building a community of health for all humanity.
